<td style="text-align:center; width:20%; border:solid 1px silver" bgcolor=#{{#if:{{{bg|}}}|{{{bg}}}|FFFFFF}}>
[[{{{page}}}|{{#if: {{{text|}}}|{{{text}}}|{{{page}}}}}]]{{{ref|}}}<br />{{{combatants|}}}
</td><noinclude>


This template is one of several used to create the [[Timeline of the Galactic Civil War]]. This is used for light-colored cells, and has several parameters&mdash;"bg" for color, "page" for the battle article, the optional "text" for pipelinking, "ref" for references, and "combatants".

[[Category:Timeline utility templates]]
